pricing:
Introductory pricing (USD), effective October 2026. Final terms are set in a licence agreement signed by AugustInnovations LLC.

90-DAY PILOT — $2,500 flat
Single program site. Onboarding, BAA, and CalOMS code-set validation against the DHCS dictionary included; file layout confirmed with your county. Credited in full toward the first annual plan.

PROGRAM — $4,800 / year
Single site, up to 30 staff accounts. BAA, all updates, and email support included.

MULTI-SITE — $12,000 / year
Up to 5 sites, up to 150 staff accounts. Everything in Program, plus onboarding assistance.

COUNTY-WIDE — custom annual pricing
Unlimited sites and staff. Includes onboarding, training, and a named support contact.

The GitHub Pages build stays free at its official address. Prices exclude customer infrastructure for self-hosted office servers.
sla: Paid plans: email support with a response within 2 business days. Security fixes ship as patches as soon as they are verified. No uptime commitment is made for office servers running on customer infrastructure; the GitHub Pages build is provided as-is.
